description: Fraction of FP8 bytes identical to the official Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 checkpoint when re-quantizing an unmodified BF16 tensor with candidate block-128 recipes (scale match was 100% for all).

recipes.label: fp32 scale = amax * (1/448), divide (CPU) / B on CUDA

notes: CUDA 'divide' (B) also gives 100% on layer 0 down_proj; CPU 'divide' differs by 1 ULP on 0.09% of elements. Final recipe used: scale = amax * (1/448) in fp32, q = w / scale, scale stored as bf16.
